decision: Draft. This plan is the UI REMEDIATION (build the component layer + worked example), distinct from the orchestrator-governance disposition gate (plan 2026-06-05-004). They are complementary and independently buildable: this fixes the current design debt + provides the standard the gate's frontend pack references; the gate ensures future surface work proves quality.

Scope is FOUNDATION + Repair worked example + conformance + orphan retirement (5 features). Migrating the other six tabs onto the layer is an explicit demand-gated follow-on (one slice per tab), NOT in this plan — do not boil the ocean. Repair chosen as the worked example because it scored lowest (no stylesheet, no item list, dishonest label).

Keep the monospace operator-console identity (all 8 audit reviewers said it fits). The change is discipline not reskin: add type+spacing scales, reserve mono for commands/data + proportional for prose, make --accent mean 'interactive' only. Per docs/dashboard-design-system.md §12.

Every feature's entering-surface proof is a real-state->real-shell journey assertion (qa-sufficiency-contract.md), extending dashboard-journey.test.js — not render-helper snapshots. F004's conformance checks (no-unstyled-emitted-class + token-only) are the automated guard that the unstyled-render bug class cannot recur.

REVIEW FIX (F004 contradiction): conformance is TIERED, not whole-suite. Blocking subset = shared primitives (base + component CSS) + migrated Repair + the orphan-CSS guard. Unmigrated tabs go in an explicit OFFENDER LEDGER; a test asserts the detector reports exactly that backlog WITHOUT failing the suite. token-only is likewise blocking only on core/component/Repair; the rest is reported debt. This resolves the 'seed to FAIL while six tabs stay unmigrated' contradiction.

REVIEW FIX (F004 extraction model): the emitted-class detector is verified by synthetic pass/fail fixtures, and for migrated pages it reads the classes actually emitted from the REAL-SHELL DOM after journey boot (capturing dynamic/modifier/state classes), not by scraping static JS string literals.

REVIEW FIX (F002 a11y in jsdom): v0 asserts the focus-ring rule/token exists + controls are keyboard-focusable; true visual focus-ring proof is deferred to a later Playwright pass (not asserted in jsdom).

REVIEW FIX (F003 data-shape dependency): Repair stays a render-layer change proven from FIXTURE INPUTS for all four states. The true corrupt-cache-vs-never-ran distinction requires the state loader to PRESERVE parse/load errors instead of collapsing them to the missing-cache empty state; that loader/error-envelope change is a NAMED dependency — implemented as a bounded sub-step or the live corrupt path is deferred until the loader preserves it.

F001 DONE: core.css gains semantic color aliases + spacing scale + type scale + focus-ring tokens (none existed). New components.css (token-only) + lib/components.js render helpers: Button, CopyCommand (data-copy + aria-live feedback + honest 'Copy' label), Card (status accents), StatTile/StatStrip, SectionHeader, Banner, Skeleton. Loaded after core.css in index.html. 9 component unit tests; full vitest 975 passed. No page behavior change yet — primitives enter the real shell via F003.

F002 DONE: page-skeleton CSS (.page/.page-header/.page-summary/.page-content/.page-footer) + renderPageHTML helper; shell hardened — <main id=main> landmark + skip-to-content link (index.html + setup.js test shell), global :focus-visible rule using --focus-ring, nav reordered to task priority (Health moved ahead of Architecture; pageModules + drift-guard test updated). New shell-hardening-f002.test.js boots the real shell and asserts main/skip-link/nav-order/focusable-tabs + the CSS token/rule. Full vitest 980 passed.
